notes.why_in_news: India reaffirmed its commitment to Sri Lanka's recovery efforts following Cyclone Ditwah through humanitarian assistance.
notes.fact_box: PM Modi spoke with Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake on December 1, 2025, assuring continued support under Operation Sagar Bandhu. India dispatched INS Vikrant, INS Udaygiri, and MI-17 helicopters, and has provided 53 tonnes of relief material.

prelims_pointers.text: Operation Sagar Bandhu is India's ongoing assistance mission to Sri Lanka.
NDRF teams were dispatched to Sri Lanka for search and rescue operations.
India has provided 53 tonnes of relief material to Sri Lanka so far.
President Anura Kumara Dissanayake is the President of Sri Lanka.

notes.mains_question: How does India's humanitarian assistance in its neighbourhood reflect its foreign policy priorities?
